sunfall.name: Sunfall Regalia
sunfall.three: Fire and Ice skills deal 10% more damage for each Fire and Ice combo you own.

pyre.name: Pyre Vanguard
pyre.three: Fire and Physical skills deal 10% more damage for each Fire and Physical combo you own.

rot.name: Rotcrown Vestments
rot.three: Fire and Chaos skills deal 10% more damage for each Fire and Chaos combo you own.

fortune.name: Fortune's Favour
fortune.three: Fire and Lightning skills deal 10% more damage for each Fire and Lightning combo you own.

lotus.name: Raiment of the Frozen Lotus
lotus.three: Ice and Lightning skills deal 10% more damage for each Ice and Lightning combo you own.

glacier.name: Glacier Sovereign
glacier.three: Ice and Physical skills deal 10% more damage for each Ice and Physical combo you own.

hollow.name: Rites of the Hollow Moon
hollow.three: Ice and Chaos skills deal 10% more damage for each Ice and Chaos combo you own.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller's Vestige
stormcaller.three: Lightning and Chaos skills deal 10% more damage for each Lightning and Chaos combo you own.

impaler.name: Impaler's Harness
impaler.three: Lightning and Physical skills deal 10% more damage for each Lightning and Physical combo you own.

bloodforged.name: Bloodforged Panoply
bloodforged.three: Physical and Chaos skills deal 10% more damage for each Physical and Chaos combo you own.

chronicle.name: Warden's Chronicle
chronicle.three: +1 cast slot and +3 Charge. Your skills deal 6% more damage for each filled ritual slot.

starfall.name: Regalia of the Fallen Star
starfall.two: Pyre Lotus can grant a Lotus twice per cast.
starfall.three: Convergence spending 2 or more Lotus calls a falling star: 2 more hits at 4% of the first hit.
starfall.awakened: The falling star leaves 1 Lotus behind.

twinSun.name: Vestments of the Twin Sun
twinSun.two: Twin Sun's repeat deals 280% more damage on its first hit instead of 100%.
twinSun.three: When both suns repeat in one ritual, your last cast repeats once more.
twinSun.awakened: Twin Sun's repeat leaves Focus full, so your next skill repeats as well.

flurry.name: Stormedge Panoply
flurry.three: At full Momentum, every hit adds a gust that deals 6% of that hit.

thousandCuts.name: Scarlord's Harness
thousandCuts.two: Thousand Cuts turns on at 13 Scar.
thousandCuts.three: While Thousand Cuts is on, every 10th hit echoes 2.5% of the damage of the last 10 hits.
thousandCuts.awakened: The echo rings every 8th hit instead of every 10th.

apocalypse.name: Mantle of the Last Hex
apocalypse.two: Apocalypse Invokes a third time, at 10% of the bank.
apocalypse.three: After the last Invoke, the bank gets back 5% of what it spent.
apocalypse.awakened: Each Invoke exposes the Guardian for 2 casts: it takes 20% more damage, on top of Withering Hex.

pandemonium.name: Pandemos' Revelry
pandemonium.two: Pandemonium also starts after your first cast of every ritual.
pandemonium.three: While Pandemonium is on, ignite and poison ticks deal 5% more damage.

magnumOpus.name: The Great Work
magnumOpus.two: Magnum Opus deals 12% more damage per poison stack instead of 11%.
magnumOpus.three: The final detonation happens twice; the second deals 5%.
magnumOpus.awakened: The second detonation counts every stack 1.5 times for Magnum Opus.

toxicApotheosis.name: Raiment of Apotheosis
toxicApotheosis.two: Toxic Apotheosis counts every Corrosion as 1.1.
toxicApotheosis.three: At 100% corrosion, the Guardian takes 30% more damage from every hit.
toxicApotheosis.awakened: The final detonation deals 0.05% more damage per 1% corrosion (5% more at 100%).

prophecy.name: Vestments of the Foretold
prophecy.two: Prophecy also repeats your second strongest cast, at 25% damage.
prophecy.three: If a cast beats every earlier cast of the ritual, the next cast deals 15% more damage.

eternalBlessing.name: Halcyon's Benediction
eternalBlessing.two: Each time Omen fills, your strongest buff is blessed twice.
eternalBlessing.three: While 3 or more buffs are active, every cast repeats at 5% damage and ailments (no Omen).
eternalBlessing.awakened: Each blessing makes your buffs 17% stronger instead of 15%.
